title: Multiple Bipolar Fuzzy Measures: An Application to Community Detection Problems for Networks with Additional Information
reasoning: The paper introduces a novel method for community detection using multiple bipolar fuzzy measures. Although it uses the concept of 'bipolarity' inspired by positive and negative human evidences/feelings for mathematical modeling of relations in graphs, it does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics. It is a technical paper on graph theory and fuzzy measures.
